reviews.title: Great for an average gamer.
reviews.comment: Works well and quite. Used with Ryzen 7X3D. Keeps it nice and cool.
reviews.author: Walter Pyatetsky

reviews.title: Low temps and not too loud.
reviews.comment:
Works great with my 7800x3d and 9070xt.  Louder than my old one, but its cooling a much higher end CPU than my last one (3600).
Either way...highly recommended.  System runs cool at 1440p max settings in most games.
reviews.author: Jace

reviews.title: great!
reviews.comment: Works better than my old 320MM NZXT Kraken.. Really surprised. Even 5 degrees cooler!
reviews.author: Ryker D.

reviews.title: some DOA parts but compensates by being overkill for a 9800x3d
reviews.comment:
It's a really solid and fantastic heatsink that I can't really say anything bad about, which is a good thing because mine didn't come with a screen and I just noticed one of the fans refuse to spin. I can't exactly DOA replace this as this is installed now and I can not just remove the entire heatsink for a couple days, kinda need the PC for work and games and stuff.
Edit: was able to do an Advanced Exchange so I got to replace it when the new one arrived with no downtime! Honestly it's a very good air cooler and I just had some bad luck ordering it during the holidays. If it fits, it's absolutely fantastic, and definitely quiet for an air cooler if you got both fans spinning!
